title: SDI or HDMI input
description: One input of a Blackmagic DeckLink card. Found inputs fill this in; the connector and the video mode are detected unless set.

device_number.title: Input
device_number.description: 0 is the first input of the first card, as Blackmagic Desktop Video Setup numbers them.

mode.title: Video mode
mode.description: auto follows the signal. Set one, such as 1080i50 or 1080p2997, only for a card that cannot detect it.
